blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — ZUS Coffee may have endured a disappointing 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series campaign, but veteran opposite spiker Jovelyn Gonzaga remains confident in the Thunderbelles’ future. Despite opening the conference with five straight losses and being eliminated from semifinal contention, ZUS Coffee remained determined to finish strong, beating Akari, 25-22, 22-25, 25-18, 25-21, on Tuesday at the Philsports Arena for its second consecutive victory. Gonzaga believes her younger teammates will emerge stronger from the experience. “I hope they continue to grow. These young players have such bright futures. I always joke that they’re my idols.
